derivation: Every video_id in the source training table this artefact was fitted on, identified by evaluation/training_manifest.json source_training_table.sha256. The release does not ship its exact training-ID list, and reproducing its seed-793 channel split was not attempted, so the list is a superset: it contains every video any of the seven components trained on, plus the reserved-channel videos they did not. Personalisation only uses it to exclude videos, so a superset can never let a training video into a creator's calibration; the cost is that reserved-channel videos are excluded too.
